material.exiledSector_socketable_parts.d: Raw nanite mass reclaimed from disassembled hull items. Nanoswarms are grown from it at the Hull Item Modification workbench.
material.exiledSector_augmentation_kerne: A nanoswarm programmed to grow a new modifier onto a hull item.
material.exiledSector_recalibration_kern: A nanoswarm that re-tunes every modifier on a hull item, rerolling its explicit values.
material.exiledSector_transposition_kern: A nanoswarm that reshapes a unique hull item into a different unique hull item.
A nanoswarm that reworks a hull item's core structure, rerolling its implicit values.
material.exiledSector_substitution_kerne: A nanoswarm that dismantles one random modifier of a hull item and replaces it with a new one.
material.exiledSector_fixation_kernel.de: Makes one random modifier on a hull item immutable. Needs at least two modifiers, and a hull item can only have one immutable modifier.
Corrupts an item, modifying it unpredictably.
material.exiledSector_prefix_ward.name: Prefix Inhibitor
material.exiledSector_prefix_ward.descri: While on, the next nanoswarm or cipher leaves existing prefixes unchanged.
material.exiledSector_suffix_ward.name: Suffix Inhibitor
material.exiledSector_suffix_ward.descri: While on, the next nanoswarm or cipher leaves existing suffixes unchanged.
material.exiledSector_replication_kernel: Extremely rare Domain-grade self-replicating seed stock that builds a mirrored copy of a hull item. Mirrored items cannot be modified.
